# WGPU & Naga in gpui-os (v30.0.0)

> Pure-Rust WebGPU graphics/compute stack (`wgpu` v30.0.0, rev `cddb2f5d80dc0009b2ef6767635140cacf90a007`) and `naga` v30.0.0 shader compiler vendored in `vendor/wgpu`, driving GPU UI rendering in `crates/gpui_wgpu`, live WGSL shader views/effects/transitions in `crates/nsh-core` + `crates/nsh-engine`, and CLI diagnostics/transpilation/headless execution in `crates/wgpu_cli` (`gpui-wgpu`).

## Core Facts & Revision Invariants

- **Pinned Revision**: `cddb2f5d80dc0009b2ef6767635140cacf90a007` (`wgpu` 30.0.0 + `naga` 30.0.0). Note: crates.io `30.0.1` lacks the Vulkan surface-drop fix (`wgpu#10230`) and WebGL resize fix (`wgpu#10348`), so `gpui-os` vendors this exact commit.
- **Shared Naga/WGPU Invariant**: `wgpu`, `wgpu-core`, `wgpu-hal`, and `naga` MUST resolve from the exact same `vendor/wgpu` tree so `ShaderSource::Wgsl`, `naga::Module`, `Capabilities`, and runtime bounds-check policies remain binary- and semantically identical across compile-time validation and GPU execution.
- **Coordinate System**: D3D/Metal conventions — NDC X in `[-1, 1]`, NDC Y in `[-1, 1]` (Y up in clip space), NDC Z (depth) in `[0, 1]`, texture UV origin `(0, 0)` at top-left (`Y` down).
- **Critical Alignment Constants** (`wgpu_types`):
  - `COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT = 256` (required on `CommandEncoder::copy_texture_to_buffer` / `copy_buffer_to_texture`; NOT required on `Queue::write_texture`).
  - `COPY_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT = 4`, `MAP_ALIGNMENT = 8`, `VERTEX_ALIGNMENT = 4`, `IMMEDIATE_DATA_ALIGNMENT = 4`, `QUERY_RESOLVE_BUFFER_ALIGNMENT = 256`.

## Vendored Crate Map (`vendor/wgpu/`)

- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu/src/lib.rs): High-level safe Rust WebGPU API (`Instance`, `Adapter`, `Device`, `Queue`, `Surface`, `Buffer`, `Texture`, `TextureView`, `Sampler`, `BindGroup`, `RenderPipeline`, `ComputePipeline`, `CommandEncoder`, `RenderPass`, `ComputePass`, `RenderBundle`, `QuerySet`, `Blas`/`Tlas`). Dispatches to `wgpu-core` on native/WebGL and browser `navigator.gpu` on WASM WebGPU, plus `custom` backend trait hooks.
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-core/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-core/src/lib.rs): Safe state-tracking & validation engine (`Global`, `Hub`, generational `Id<T>`, `SnatchLock`, per-resource `Tracker` state machines, automatic barrier emission, indirect draw/dispatch compute validation, lazy zero-initialization).
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/lib.rs): Unsafe zero-overhead hardware abstraction (`Api` trait + `Instance`, `Adapter`, `Device`, `Queue`, `CommandEncoder`, `Surface`). Backends:
  - `dx12` (`vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/dx12/`): Direct3D 12 via `windows` `0.62`, `gpu-allocator` `0.28`, `range-alloc` `0.1`, FXC/DXC (`mach-dxcompiler-rs`), 2048-sampler heap indirection.
  - `vulkan` (`vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/vulkan/`): Vulkan 1.1–1.3 via `ash` `0.38`, `gpu-allocator` `0.28`, timeline semaphores, imageless framebuffers.
  - `metal` (`vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/metal/`): Apple Metal via `objc2-metal` `0.3.2`, `CAMetalLayer`, `IOSurface` interop, MSL translation + vertex pulling.
  - `gles` (`vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/gles/`): OpenGL 3.3+ / GLES 3.0+ / WebGL2 via `glow` `0.18`, EGL (`khronos-egl`), WGL, and `web-sys`.
  - `noop` (`vendor/wgpu/wgpu-hal/src/noop/`): Zero-GPU stub backend for headless resource/buffer unit tests.
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-types/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-types/src/lib.rs): Backend-agnostic types (`Features`, `Limits`, `DownlevelCapabilities`, `DownlevelFlags`, `TextureFormat`, `BufferUsages`, `TextureUsages`, `Backends`, `MemoryHints`, `PollType`, `TexelCopyBufferLayout`, `TexelCopyTextureInfo`).
- [vendor/wgpu/naga/](../../vendor/wgpu/naga/src/lib.rs): Shader compiler, validator, and cross-compiler:
  - Frontends (`naga::front`): `wgsl` (`parse_str`), `glsl`, `spv`.
  - IR & Analysis (`naga::ir`, `naga::valid`, `naga::proc`): Arena-based `Module`, `Validator` (`ValidationFlags`, `Capabilities`, control-flow `Uniformity`), `Layouter` (WGSL size/alignment), `Typifier`, `ConstantEvaluator`, `BoundsCheckPolicies`, `process_overrides`.
  - Backends (`naga::back`): `wgsl`, `hlsl` (SM 5.0–6.9), `msl` (MSL 1.0–3.x), `spv` (SPIR-V 1.0–1.6), `glsl` (Desktop 330–460, ES 300/310/320 + WebGL2), `dot`.
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-naga-bridge/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-naga-bridge/src/lib.rs): Maps `wgpu-types` `Features`/`Limits` to `naga::valid::Validator` `Capabilities` and shader stage flags.
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-sync/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-sync/src/lib.rs): `Send`/`Sync` mutex/rwlock/atomic wrappers portable across `std`, `no_std`, and single-threaded WASM.
- [vendor/wgpu/wgpu-info/](../../vendor/wgpu/wgpu-info/src/main.rs), [player/](../../vendor/wgpu/player/), [cts_runner/](../../vendor/wgpu/cts_runner/), [deno_webgpu/](../../vendor/wgpu/deno_webgpu/): Upstream adapter reporter, trace player, WebGPU CTS runner, and Deno WebGPU bindings.

## GPUI & NSH Integration Map

- [crates/gpui_wgpu/src/gpui_wgpu.rs](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/gpui_wgpu.rs): Public entry point re-exporting `WgpuContext`, `WgpuRenderer`, `WgpuHeadlessRenderer`, `WgpuSurfaceConfig`, `WgpuAtlas`, `CosmicTextSystem`, and `wgpu`.
- [crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_context.rs](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_context.rs): Hybrid-GPU-safe adapter sorting (`ZED_DEVICE_ID` -> compositor GPU PCI match -> Discrete > Integrated > Other > Virtual > Cpu -> Vulkan/Metal/DX12 > GL), live surface configuration probe inside `ErrorFilter::Validation` scope, `DUAL_SOURCE_BLENDING` negotiation, `MemoryHints::MemoryUsage`, and `DeviceErrorState` (`set_device_lost_callback` + `on_uncaptured_error` generation counter).
- [crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_renderer.rs](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_renderer.rs): Single-pass batched GPU UI renderer with 9 pipelines (`opaque_quads`, `quads`, `shadows`, `path_tiles`, `underlines`, `mono_sprites`, `subpixel_sprites`, `poly_sprites`, `surfaces`), reverse-Z depth (`Depth32Float`, `CompareFunction::Greater`) for front-to-back opaque quad occlusion, storage-buffer instance transport + `Rgba32Uint` texture fallback for WebGL2, multi-window device loss recovery (`recover`), Android/Web surface unconfigure/replace, and `WgpuHeadlessRenderer` PNG readback.
- [crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_atlas.rs](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_atlas.rs): `etagere::BucketedAtlasAllocator` texture cache managing `R8Unorm` (monochrome), `Bgra8Unorm`/`Rgba8Unorm` (subpixel & polychrome) 2D textures with deferred `queue.write_texture` uploads and generation-tracked bind group invalidation.
- [crates/gpui_wgpu/src/shaders.wgsl](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/shaders.wgsl), [shaders_storage.wgsl](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/shaders_storage.wgsl), [shaders_webgl.wgsl](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/shaders_webgl.wgsl), [shaders_subpixel.wgsl](../../crates/gpui_wgpu/src/shaders_subpixel.wgsl): UI primitive SDF shaders, Oklab/sRGB gradients, Analytic curve path tiles, DirectWrite-style gamma/contrast enhancement, and `enable dual_source_blending;` `@blend_src(0)`/`@blend_src(1)` subpixel antialiasing.
- [crates/nsh-core/src/shader.rs](../../crates/nsh-core/src/shader.rs): App-authored `fn shade(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f` compiler. Validates user source via `naga`, forbids user resource bindings/entry points, reflects `struct Uniforms` offsets/types, detects `nsh.time` animation and `sample_content`/`sample_backdrop`/`sample_from`/`sample_to` dependencies, wraps with `nsh_vertex` + `nsh_fragment`, and optionally cross-compiles to GLSL ES 300 for WebGL2.
- [crates/nsh-engine/src/shader.rs](../../crates/nsh-engine/src/shader.rs): Non-blocking offscreen WGPU renderer (`Renderer` + per-view `ShaderView`) with double-buffered `MAP_READ` staging readback (`IDLE` -> `MAPPING` -> `MAPPED`), `MemoryHints::MemoryUsage`, 65,536 `max_non_sampler_bindings` cap for DX12 heap sizing, and zero-copy Apple `IOSurface` rendering.

## CLI Tool (`gpui-wgpu` in `crates/wgpu_cli`)

- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- adapters [--backends all|vulkan|dx12|metal|gl] [--limits] [--features] [--json]`: Enumerates physical/software GPU adapters, PCI IDs, driver info, subgroup sizes, downlevel capabilities, texture format support, features, and limits.
- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- validate <shader.wgsl> [--json]`: Parses and validates WGSL via `naga`, emits source-span diagnostics on failure, and reflects entry points, workgroup sizes, `@group`/`@binding` globals, address spaces, struct layouts (`Layouter`), overrides, and immediates.
- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- transpile <shader.wgsl> --target <wgsl|glsl|glsl-webgl2|hlsl|msl|spv> [--stage vertex|fragment|compute] [--entry <name>] [-o <out>]`: Cross-compiles validated WGSL to HLSL, Metal MSL, Desktop/ES/WebGL2 GLSL, canonical WGSL, or SPIR-V binary.
- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- render <shader.wgsl> -o <output.png> [--width 800] [--height 600] [--time 0.0] [--entry fs_main]`: Headless offscreen fullscreen render with optional `@group(0) @binding(0)` uniform `{ resolution: vec2<f32>, time: f32, _pad: f32 }`, 256-byte row alignment stripping, and PNG export.
- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- compute <shader.wgsl> [--entry main] [--workgroups 1,1,1] [--output-floats 64] [--json]`: Headless WGSL compute dispatch with `@group(0) @binding(0)` `read_write` storage buffer and `MAP_READ` staging readback.
- `cargo run -p wgpu_cli -- bench [--iterations 50] [--size 1024] [--json]`: Measures GPU adapter/device startup latency, `queue.write_buffer` upload bandwidth (GB/s), compute dispatch latency, and offscreen render pass throughput.
